scalars.scalar_value: Experience working with a CMMS system (Maximo strongly preferred).
Experience supporting facilities, compliance, regulatory, or engineering operations.

items.item_text: Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Six years of related experience, education/training, OR a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus two years of related regulatory experience/training.
Experience supporting facilities, compliance, regulatory, or engineering operations.
Experience working with a CMMS system (Maximo strongly preferred).
Experience creating, processing, and closing work orders and reports.

This position will report to the Facilities Engineering Regulatory and Compliance supervisor, supporting continuous audit preparedness and modernization, as well as handling day to day regulatory questions. The position will require operational execution and process management. Unlike strategy or project management roles that focus on long-term planning, organizational transformation, and cross-functional initiatives, this role emphasizes hands-on ownership of specific processes, accurate execution of tasks, and ongoing operational support. They will be responsible for assisting with request close out and validation on a day-to-day basis.
